hold_reason: Refund mismatch: W2 (Alpha Co) reported refunds applied for orders 250 (14546), 251 (1481), and 255 (12535), but list_refunds shows only orders 250 and 255. Order 251 (customer birch, order amount 2763) has no matching ledger refund of 1481 cents. Paying birch from net_balance could overpay or underpay, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs confirmation of whether the order 251 refund was applied before payouts proceed.
